description: Navigation toolbar for the scheduler with previous/next/today buttons, a date title, and view switcher tabs (Day, Week, Month, Agenda, Timeline). Typically used internally by TmScheduler. Accessibility: the title is aria-live=polite and the view switcher is a radiogroup of radios with one roving tab stop.

parameters.name: CurrentDate
parameters.description: Currently displayed date. The Month title is this date's month.

parameters.name: RangeStart
parameters.description: Inclusive start of the range the title describes. The scheduler fills it from the same range it loads. Day and Timeline titles show this day; Week and Agenda titles start here.

parameters.name: RangeEnd
parameters.description: Exclusive end of the range the title describes. Week and Agenda titles cover [RangeStart, RangeEnd - 1].

parameters.name: OnViewChange
parameters.description: Fires when the user clicks a view button.

parameters.name: OnPrev
parameters.description: Fires when the user clicks Previous.

parameters.name: OnNext
parameters.description: Fires when the user clicks Next.

parameters.name: OnToday
parameters.description: Fires when the user clicks Today.

parameters.name: ShowPrint
parameters.description: Whether to show the Print button.

parameters.name: OnPrint
parameters.description: Fires when the user clicks Print.

examples.title: Standalone toolbar
examples.code: <TmSchedulerToolbar View="TmScheduleViewType.Month" CurrentDate="DateTime.Today" OnViewChange="@HandleViewChange" OnPrev="@HandlePrev" OnNext="@HandleNext" OnToday="@HandleToday" />
